summary: Type-selected UI text field initializer. Switches on the text-field type selector at this+0x304 (cases 0x1AF..0x1B5). Each case clears a global buffer, binds that buffer to the text field through UtilityFunction_b7e0 (this, &buffer, length), sets the mode field this+0x2E8 (0 or 2), and for the password-mask types also sets the placeholder string pointer this+0x2FC to a mask literal. Case 0x1B3 instead routes through BoundedFieldSetter(this, 0xA0) and sets the flag byte this+0xE5 to 1. Case 0x1B5 clears its buffer and falls through to the default return 0. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Switch dispatch on the text-field type selector at this+0x304, selecting a case by the jump table at 0x004703E0.
Case 0x1AF: clear the global buffer byte_7CD818 to 0.
Case 0x1AF: bind the cleared buffer to the text field via UtilityFunction_b7e0(this, &byte_7CD818, 26).
Case 0x1AF: point this+0x2FC at the mask/placeholder string aWwwwwwwwwwwwww, then fall to the shared return 0.
Case 0x1B0: clear byte_7CD834 to 0 and set the mode field this+0x2E8 to 0.
Case 0x1B0: bind the buffer via UtilityFunction_b7e0(this, &byte_7CD834, 26).
Case 0x1B0: point this+0x2FC at the second mask/placeholder string aWwwwwwwwwwwwww_0, then fall to the shared return 0.
Case 0x1B1: clear byte_7CD850 to 0 and set the mode field this+0x2E8 to 0.
Case 0x1B1: bind the buffer via UtilityFunction_b7e0(this, &byte_7CD850, 15), then fall to the shared return 0.
Case 0x1B2: bind the uninitialized buffer via UtilityFunction_b7e0(this, &unk_7CD860, 32).
Case 0x1B2: set the mode field this+0x2E8 to 2, then fall to the shared return 0.
Case 0x1B3: set the mode field this+0x2E8 to 0.
Case 0x1B3: run the bounded field setter BoundedFieldSetter(this, 0xA0).
Case 0x1B3: set the flag byte this+0xE5 to 1, then fall to the shared return 0.
Case 0x1B5: bind the buffer via UtilityFunction_b7e0(this, &byte_7CD880, 32), then fall through to the default.
Default/fall-through path and every case conclude with return 0.

unresolved: The identity of the object owning this text field and the exact meaning of the global buffers (byte_7CD818/7CD834/7CD850/7CD860/7CD880) is unknown; they appear to be track/multiplayer-input buffers per the existing analysis but are not proven here.
What UtilityFunction_b7e0 does with (this, &buffer, length) and why case 0x1B3 uses the distinct BoundedFieldSetter path instead is unresolved.
The type-selector enum values 0x1AF-0x1B5 are used as-is without a confirmed semantic mapping.
